columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Time the event was ingested into the workspace.

columns.name: SchemaVersion
columns.description: Envelope schema version (1).

columns.name: EventId
columns.description: Unique event id (UUID).

columns.name: Seq
columns.description: Feed sequence number; the connector's cursor.

columns.name: EventType
columns.description: ghost.seen, ghost.deployed, ghost.retired or ghost.verified.

columns.name: Kind
columns.description: Ghost kind: IDENTITY today; TOKEN, DECOY, SENSOR later.

columns.name: Subtype
columns.description: ghost.seen match subtype: EXACT_PAIR, EMAIL_OTHER_PASSWORD or EMAIL_ONLY.

columns.name: Severity
columns.description: DarkStrata severity: INFO, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH or CRITICAL.

columns.name: IsTest
columns.description: True for self-test events.

columns.name: ObservedAt
columns.description: When the leak was observed, if known.

columns.name: ReceivedAt
columns.description: When DarkStrata recorded the event.

columns.name: GhostId
columns.description: Ghost public id.

columns.name: GhostLabel
columns.description: Customer-written ghost label. Untrusted text.

columns.name: GhostSeedUrl
columns.description: Where the ghost was seeded, if recorded.

columns.name: GhostMode
columns.description: asset or pool.

columns.name: GhostEmail
columns.description: Ghost address (ghost.seen only).

columns.name: GhostDisplayName
columns.description: Ghost display name (ghost.seen only).

columns.name: MatchKind
columns.description: How the ghost matched the leaked row.

columns.name: MatchSource
columns.description: STEALER_LOG, BREACH or COMBOLIST.

columns.name: CorpusName
columns.description: Name of the leaked corpus. Untrusted text.

columns.name: RowIngestedAt
columns.description: When DarkStrata ingested the leaked row.

columns.name: MatchProvenance
columns.description: Provenance details from the leak. Untrusted text.

columns.name: Incident
columns.description: Reserved; null today.

columns.name: MitreAttackVersion
columns.description: ATT&CK version of the tags.

columns.name: MitreDomain
columns.description: ATT&CK domain (enterprise-attack).

columns.name: MitreTechniques
columns.description: Array of {id, name, parent_name, tactic_ids, basis}.

columns.name: MitreSoftware
columns.description: Array of ATT&CK software tags.

columns.name: RetiredById
columns.description: ghost.retired: id of the user or API key that retired the ghost.

columns.name: RetiredByName
columns.description: ghost.retired: name of the user or API key.

columns.name: RetiredReason
columns.description: ghost.retired: asset_deleted when the ghost's domain was deleted.

columns.name: UnarmedReason
columns.description: ghost.unarmed: why the ghost is not armed (no_domain, domain_disabled, domain_unverified, not_checked_recently, domain_inactive).

columns.name: VerifiedArmed
columns.description: ghost.verified: true; ghost.unarmed: false.

columns.name: LastCheckedAt
columns.description: ghost.verified and ghost.unarmed: when DarkStrata last finished a check of the ghost's domain.

columns.name: LastTestAt
columns.description: ghost.verified and ghost.unarmed: the ghost's last self-test alert, if any.

columns.name: TokenType
columns.description: Ghost token type (WEB_URL, QR, OFFICE_DOC, ENTRA_CSS, WEBHOOK_URL); token events only.

columns.name: Placement
columns.description: Where the ghost was planted (FILE_SHARE, WIKI, …), when the customer said.

columns.name: SrcIp
columns.description: Token hits: the IP address that used the token.

columns.name: UserAgent
columns.description: Token hits: the caller's user agent. Untrusted text.

columns.name: SrcCountry
columns.description: Token hits: country of SrcIp (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

columns.name: SrcAsn
columns.description: Token hits: autonomous system number of SrcIp.

columns.name: SrcAsOrg
columns.description: Token hits: network owner of SrcIp.

columns.name: SrcIsTor
columns.description: Token hits: SrcIp is a Tor exit node (empty when unknown).

columns.name: SrcIsHosting
columns.description: Token hits: SrcIp is on a hosting or cloud network.

columns.name: PhishingHost
columns.description: Entra CSS token hits: the adversary-in-the-middle proxy host.

columns.name: ConsoleUrl
columns.description: Link to the ghost in the DarkStrata console.
